column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Square Enix, Unreal Engine 5.6.1 (the desktop renderer) on SDK 20.5.17, update 1.0.1. The shaders are Oodle-compressed in the IoStore container's two shader libraries:
# the port decodes them with the game's own decoder on the device (porter device_ue_shaders, one round of 5,919 groups, 146 MB → 671 MB, under a minute), and the split's tables
# match the iOS profile's byte for byte. All 73,496 shaders translate to SPIR-V.
# On a POCO F7 (25053PC47G, Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, Adreno 825, Android 16; 2026-10-31): boot, the opening movie and cutscene, the title, Continue into the first field and its tutorials, the
# pause menu's docked / handheld switch. Its Niagara particle data is in buffer textures 32 bytes past a 64-byte boundary, which Adreno 825 will not view: read through
# an aligned copy (gfx_vk_tex.c tbuf_shadow), no red line left.
# Speed: handheld. The game sends 9 submissions a frame, and with 6 submission slots each frame's main submission waited for the GPU to finish the last
# frame's other large one (DM_NVN_SEQ: ~37 ms a frame in the replay), so a frame was the replay plus the GPU's work. With 16 slots (gfx_vk_core.c NSLOT), from
# one save in the Earth Shrine: frame p50 45 ms → 33 ms, submit+present 40 → 16 ms (DM_VK_SLOTS=6 / 16, same build). The busiest view seen before the fix
# (about 2,700 draws) took 76 ms: replay 33 ms (descriptor sets 10-16 ms; 66-72% of the new sets were in the last 20 submissions, DM_VK_SETX) and GPU 43 ms.
# Docked (1920x1080) the GPU alone took 27-45 ms in the opening. Pipelines compile in 70-220 ms each on this Adreno, so the first sight of a material stalls
# a frame for up to 2 s; the next boot prewarms them (graphics and compute, vk_pipelines.bin / vk_cpipelines.bin): 0 long frames in a second run through the
# same field (55 in the first). DM_NVN_ASYNC=1 does not run: the game raises Unreal's LowLevelFatalError at boot (abort at main+0x11bc).
# The game's 30 (the Switch's rate) rather than the profile's 60 (env below): the phone holds neither, and 30 keeps the pacing steady.
